branches.conclusion: The complete current nine-programme research-postgraduate inventory names Accounting and Business Management but no formal Operations or Management Science programme. The full Accounting and Business Management page names the Faculty of Business and Management, a PhD awarded by Hong Kong Baptist University, and supervisor research fields including Management Science and supply-chain topics. Those are individual research interests, not official programme, named specialization or department/school titles. Thus this current BNBU-delivered route does not satisfy the exact-title register rule.

The complete current research postgraduate inventory and expanded descriptions of Applied Mathematics, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, and Computer Science and Technology establish no formally named Operations or Industrial Engineering doctorate, specialization or relevant named host unit.
